name: invocal-presentation-skill
description: Narration-led video production with researched scripts, synchronized visuals, editable presentations, captions and verified exports. Uses Invocal; requires compatible media tools.

interface.shortDescription: Create narrated lessons with timed visuals and verified exports
interface.longDescription: Turn a topic into a researched, narrated educational video. Includes reusable Python media-production and verification scripts, an optional compatible Work presentation adapter, narration-first teaching guidance, captions and editable slides. Uses the recipient’s own authorized Invocal connection for speech and Azure word timestamps. Requires an execution environment with FFmpeg, FFprobe, Pillow and NumPy, plus editable slide authoring and rendering. Installing this package does not provide external accounts, private narration jobs, media executables or the Work-only slide runtime. Baseline support covers timed reveals, focus markers and short dissolves; richer chart animation and presenter avatars are not yet validated.
defaultPrompt: Create a three-minute educational video about [topic] for [audience] using Invocal narration.
Check Invocal Presentation Skill setup: verify my Invocal connection and the media and presentation tools.
